content.rationale: The package is named deccy-cli with exactly one binary target, named `deccy` (M-name, utykmuns): one CLI for humans and agents alike, built from the Rust choice. Edition 2021 is supported by every toolchain in practical use; moving newer is a later decision once a toolchain premise exists. The manifest declares the serde and serde_json dependencies the serde choice fixes, the jsonschema dependency the validator choice fixes, and the assert_cmd and tempfile dev-dependencies the acceptance-suite choice fixes for the black-box suites. No lib target as product surface: no library API has been decided. A lib target exists solely so integration tests can reach the boundary through the same path production uses; the binary remains the only surface anyone runs. The version number is stamped from the version decision above, not chosen here. The manifest also declares the package's public identity — its license (M-license), its source repository (M-hosting), and its crates.io keywords and categories (M-listing) — so the crate is legally usable and discoverable wherever it is listed. The manifest also declares the profile release builds use: a `dist` profile inheriting `release` with thin LTO. The manifest implements the packaged-file-set decision (xrvrslzq) with an explicit cargo `include` allowlist — `/src`, `/schemas`, `/README.md`, `/LICENSE-MIT`, `/LICENSE-APACHE`: a published crate carries only the paths that decision names, the sources that build the binary, the schemas the binary embeds at build time, and the README and two licence texts the listing and the licence require, while `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` travel with the build because cargo always includes them. The mechanisms that decision excludes stay in the repository and out of the archive: the graph's own state under `nodes/`, the models under `specs/`, the CI workflows under `.github/`, the release machinery in `dist-workspace.toml`, and the development-only black-box suites and their fixtures under `tests/`. An allowlist is what makes the shipped set closed: new development material cannot join the package by default, and widening the set takes an edit to this manifest.
